Date: Tue, May 30, 2028 at 9:12 AM PDT
Subject: Vendor profile wizard + PO routing: action required

Hi Lily (and Novatools finance team),

Thanks again for the call earlier. To get Novatools fully live in our procurement system and ensure POs route correctly, can you please complete the vendor profile wizard in the link below and upload the requested documents? We need the vendor master created before we issue the first PO.

Action items:
- Complete the vendor profile wizard: https://app.redwood.com/vendor-wizard/entry/NT-9981 (estimated 10–15 mins)
- Upload: current W-9 (or W-8 if non-US), copy of bank instructions or ACH template, and a remit address confirmation
- Confirm primary AP contact name, email, and preferred invoice currency

Once those are submitted we'll create the vendor master (expected 1–3 business days) and confirm the PO channel. If you prefer, we can also accept a signed onboarding packet via DocuSign — tell me which you prefer.

I attached the onboarding checklist for reference.

Thanks — ping me if anything is unclear.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0123
Attachment: Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Lily Tran <lily.tran@novatools.co>

Date: Tue, May 30, 2028 at 11:02 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Vendor profile wizard + PO routing: action required

Hi Aisha — thanks, we can do this today. A couple quick clarifications before we upload: 

1) Tax form: Novatools is a US-registered C-corp, so we'll upload a W-9. Is a scanned PDF of the W-9 acceptable or do you need an original?
2) Invoice currency: our finance team prefers to invoice in EUR for EMEA deals. Will Redwood accept EUR invoices or should we request USD PO conversion?

We attached our completed W-9 to this reply. If you need any additional corporate docs (certificate of incorporation, beneficial owner declaration), let us know and we'll attach them.

Thanks,
Lily Tran
Head of Partnerships | Novatools Inc.
lily.tran@novatools.co
Attachment: Novatools_W9.pdf (attached by Novatools)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>

Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, May 30, 2028 at 1:30 PM PDT
Subject: Re: Vendor profile wizard + PO routing: action required

Hi Lily — great, and thanks for the quick turnaround. Short answers:

- Scanned PDF of a signed W-9 is fine for our vendor master intake. If anything requires notarization we'll flag that later.
- Currency: Redwood issues POs in USD by default. We can support EUR invoicing, but that requires setting the vendor's invoice currency on the master record and an AP routing exception. Kimberly (cc'd) can enable EUR as the invoice currency and confirm whether POs should be created in EUR or converted.

Next steps for Novatools to finish today:
- Confirm remit address in the vendor wizard exactly as you want it on invoices
- Upload the W-9 (done) and ACH/Wire instructions if you prefer electronic payment
- Confirm primary AP contact (email that will receive PO and remittance)

Aisha: once Novatools confirms remit & AP contact, can we route the master to Kimberly for the invoice-currency toggle and then Marissa for the PO-channel configuration?

Lily: sample portal screenshot attached showing where to place remit/bank info.

Thanks — Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment: VendorProfile_Wizard_Screenshot.png (inline)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Lily Tran <lily.tran@novatools.co>, Novatools Finance <invoices@novatools.co>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, May 31, 2028 at 3:03 PM PDT
Subject: Re: Vendor profile wizard + PO routing: action required

Thanks everyone — confirming on Redwood's end: we received the W-9 and I can confirm the legal name on the intake is "Novatools Inc." and the remit address matches the uploaded document.

I've enabled EUR as an invoice currency for the Novatools master (Master ID NT-9981). Per our policy, POs will typically be issued in USD unless the buyer's SOW specifically requests EUR pricing; if your preferred setup is EUR-native POs, Carlos or your AP team should confirm that on the portal and we'll set the default.

Next steps and timeline:
- Lily / Novatools: please confirm ACH/Routing details or advise if you only accept wires (reply to this thread).
- Once remit and bank details are confirmed, Marissa will finalize PO channel mapping (expected internal completion: 1 business day).
- Target go-live for PO issuance: Mon, Jun 3, 2028 (assuming bank details confirmed by EOD Fri, Jun 1).

If anything changes let me know. Looking forward to getting Novatools on the platform.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Vendor Onboarding | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
